rows.mappingNote: New day-in-question article, 当日 とうじつ 1449210:1.
rows.sourceNote: Future or past reference is event-relative, not necessarily today or a personal appointment. Preserve the raw appointed-day gloss without making appointment compulsory.

source.waller_definition: letter to the editor,letter from a reader,contribution

rows.mappingNote: New submitted-letter/contribution article, 投書 とうしょ 1447270:1,2.
rows.sourceNote: Noun and suru expression for letters/opinions/complaints to press or institutions and publication contributions, not every personal letter or monetary contribution.

rows.mappingNote: New stage/fiction appearance article, 登場 とうじょう 1444800:1; also teach people/products emerging on the scene, sense2.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive suru use extends to market arrival; not attendance or physical appearance alone. Mixed public headings must not introduce the separate とじょう reading into this identity.

rows.mappingNote: New speaker-assessed inevitability/resignation article, どうせ 1008950:1; conditional might-as-well sense2 also taught.
rows.sourceNote: Raw anyway/at-any-rate gloss lacks the attitudinal restriction. The conditional can make a constructive suggestion; not every use is pessimistic or every neutral anyway replaceable.

rows.mappingNote: New exact kana greeting, どうぞよろしく 1008960:1; regards sense2 and recognized どうぞ宜しく spelling explained.
rows.sourceNote: Compare existing 宜しく/よろしく and longer お願いします formula, without inventing a はじめまして article. The public endpoint returned no lexical body; JMdict and inspected existing article support are not represented as a successful public greeting lookup.

rows.mappingNote: New lighthouse article, 灯台 とうだい 1448730:1; historical indoor fixture sense2 explicitly separated.
rows.sourceNote: Older 燈台 spelling recognized; mixed public plant/どうだん heading is not this word. Historical fixture is not the modern coastal referent. Add reciprocal 灯 links.

rows.mappingNote: New theft/property-stolen article, 盗難 とうなん 1448500:1.
rows.sourceNote: Noun in 盗難に遭う, not an ordinary thief-agent 盗難する verb. Raw robbery gloss does not require force or threats; compare actual 強盗/泥棒/盗む senses.

rows.mappingNote: New turn-on-duty/person-on-duty article, 当番 とうばん 1449220:1.
rows.sourceNote: Rotating/scheduled responsibility, one's turn or the assigned person; not every job or obligation. Compare actual turn, duty and person-in-charge labels without inheriting all their neighboring guards.

rows.mappingNote: New equal-division article, 等分 とうぶん 1449510:1.
rows.sourceNote: Transitive suru; number+等分 specifies shares. Equality of size/quantity/cost does not imply fairness under every rule or restrict division to two halves.

rows.mappingNote: New transparency/clear-quality article, 透明 とうめい 1450590:1.
rows.sourceNote: Correct the overbroad raw cleanness gloss while preserving it. Visible transparency does not guarantee hygiene or drinkability. Actual public body also supports clear voice; avoid a physical-only ban. No missing 透 card fabricated.

rows.mappingNote: New kerosene/paraffin-fuel article, 灯油 とうゆ 1448760:1.
rows.sourceNote: Specific petroleum fuel, not cooking oil or gasoline. 石油:2 and オイル:5 explicitly share kerosene, stronger than category proximity alone. Separate mixed historical public readings; add reciprocal 灯 and 油 links.

rows.mappingNote: New Asian-East regional article, 東洋 とうよう 1448230:1; dated China-used Japan sense2 qualified, not modern default.
rows.sourceNote: Public scope includes Japan/China/India; do not fix an exclusively East-Asian or pan-Asian boundary. Raw Orient retained as source wording, not the only English explanation.

rows.mappingNote: New children's-story/fairy-tale article, 童話 どうわ 1454000:1.
rows.sourceNote: Neither literal fairies nor an anonymous folk origin are compulsory. Separate literary category from myth and unrelated magazine-title heading. Add reciprocal 童 links.

rows.mappingNote: New exact happens-to-pass article, 通り掛かる とおりかかる 1432940:1; 通りかかる explicitly recognized.
rows.sourceNote: Godan, source spelling retained. Passing a place with を does not change the place or require stopping for a visit. Do not recommend search-only 通り掛る/通りがかる as equivalent teaching spellings.

rows.mappingNote: New transitive melt/dissolve article, 溶かす とかす 1546040:1,2; colloquial financial loss sense3 separately taught.
rows.sourceNote: Differentiate agent/object from intransitive 溶ける and mixing 溶く; colloquial squander is money-specific, not every loss. Add reciprocal 溶 links.

source.waller_definition: to taper to a point,to become sharp,to be sour,to look displeased

rows.mappingNote: New pointed/on-edge/sharp-manner article, 尖る とがる 1389970:1,2,3; provocative/rebellious sense4 and reading とんがる recognized.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive godan; state can be expressed with 尖っている. Raw sour means displeased demeanor, not acidity. No missing 尖 card fabricated; do not equate sharpness with loudness or cutting ability.

rows.mappingNote: Reuse existing exact どきどき card for mimetic heartbeat and suru pounding senses, 1009050:1,2; add only sourced jlpt:2.
rows.sourceNote: Existing identity, reading, title, tags, exclusions and teaching body preserved. Exact form/family searches of the pinned N5/N4 and N3 indexes find no lower-level source row; N2:1198 establishes the article label, not an inference from intuition or kana.

rows.mappingNote: New mixing/dissolving-into-liquid article, 溶く とく 1546050:1; beating eggs sense2 taught and rare melting/smelting sense3 qualified.
rows.sourceNote: Flour mixing need not be true chemical dissolution. Beating eggs is not necessarily cooking scrambled eggs. Keep separate 解く/とく solving identity; add reciprocal 溶 links.

rows.mappingNote: New step-aside article, 退く どく 1595080:1; usual kana どく taught.
rows.sourceNote: Preserve overbroad retreat/recede/withdraw raw gloss without teaching all those as どく. Sense2 resign/retire is restricted to のく; separate しりぞく/ひく families do not merge through spelling. Direct どいて can be abrupt; show a polite question.

rows.mappingNote: New special/particular-kind article, 特殊 とくしゅ 1454970:1.
rows.sourceNote: Specialized or unusual kind is not necessarily praise, superiority or numerical uniqueness. Compare 独特/特別 and actual unusualness meanings; 唯一's sole/only sense is not automatically a synonym edge. No missing 殊 card fabricated.
